title: Node never drives SCHC fragmentation retransmission or inactivity timers
description: Correctness review of Node._transmit_peer_schc/_process_received and SchcSessionManager found outbound fragmented sends emit the initial batch and immediately return True, but Node retains no sender handle, schedules no 10-second retransmission timeout, and never calls FragmentSender.timeout(). If All-1 or its ACK is lost, there is no ACK REQ/retry/Sender-Abort and no completion/failure notification; the session only expires opportunistically when a later manager method happens to run. Inbound reassembly likewise has no driven 60-second timer and therefore cannot proactively emit the Receiver-Abort required by spec/03-adaptation.md §5.6. Integrate bounded per-session timers with Node lifecycle/cancellation, handle radio-send failures for repair outputs, drive the four-attempt state machine, emit terminal aborts, and test lost All-1, lost ACK, inactivity, shutdown, and successful completion.
notes: Implemented Node-owned outbound SCHC deadline driver, ACK/repair timer reset, MAX_ACK_REQUESTS exhaustion and Sender-Abort, radio-failure abort, cancellation/shutdown cleanup, plus receive-loop proactive authenticated reassembly expiry abort transmission. Focused combined gate: 281 passed; Ruff, node mypy, diff check clean. Follow-up review beads pm99/mcgs/bz29 fixed but left open for convergence reviews.
